summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $500 million 5.680% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes were issued under an indenture with Citibank as trustee and underwritten by Goldman Sachs, Jefferies, and J.P. Morgan. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. The filing also notes a proposed redomiciliation to Bermuda, but this is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven category applies.
